name: Danjou Rei
source:
An ordinary housewife who lives across the street from the Amami family.

She is widowed and lives with her daughter Mei. She has an easygoing and cheerful personality.

In fact, she is the magical girl who fought against a princess who tried to rule the magical land in the past.
